self_description_detail: I am a PhD Candidate in Computer Science at the University of Arkansas, expected to graduate in December 2026. My work sits between AI research and engineering: I build reproducible LLM, NLP, retrieval, and evaluation systems that make model behavior easier to test and trust.

My research focuses on controllable generation, causal NLP, and adversarial robustness. I am seeking AI Engineer, ML Engineer, NLP Engineer, and research-engineering roles where I can translate rigorous experiments into dependable products.
